sources.snippet: The code model is configured separately. By default, the pipeline uses a served AesCode checkpoint. Use --provider anthropic or a hosted --base-url and --model pair to run another model. Pass --reference-image to provide your own reference and skip image drafting.

sources.title: AesCode 32B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: AesCode 32B is a 32-billion parameter open-weights model from Microsoft designed for generating editable HTML and CSS for slides, posters, dashboards, and reports.

sources.title: AesCode 32B — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility | llmrun
sources.snippet: AesCode-32B is a Microsoft research model that writes slides, posters, dashboards, and infographics as editable HTML and CSS. It starts from Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and is trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on several reward signals.
